presentation.purpose: Combine rows from one array with columns from another.

learning.title: Explore Matrix multiply in a classifier
learning.subtitle: Connect two arrays and check how their rows and columns combine.
learning.formula: Each output value combines one row from A with one column from B: multiply matching entries, then add those products.
paragraphs: The inner sizes must match: the number of columns in A equals the number of rows in B. The result keeps the rows from A and the columns from B.
A sample is one observation; a batch is a group of observations. The batch sizes must match. Extra sample directions may repeat a size-one slice to match its partner; this is called broadcasting.

Open the editable classifier, inspect both input shapes, and run to inspect the output table. The Matrix multiply lesson provides separate measured exercises for values and for how small input changes affect the result.
